Q-20260816-01 concludes that durable human-in-the-loop authorization should separate broad default policy, an occurrence-scoped exception, actor/authority evidence and external-effect evidence; exact-call persistence establishes a narrow resumable decision but not approver identity or exactly-once effects. Q-20260816-02 concludes that pre-materialization orchestration should separate reserved stable identity, bounded pending host intent, authoritative materialization and abandonment/reconciliation cleanup; reservation is correlation rather than proof of object existence, and the selected Codex mechanism is local rather than a distributed reservation transaction. Q-20260816-03 concludes that deterministic configuration precedence resolves which value wins but not provenance or authorization; raw escape hatches are safer when later execution-owned settings retain explicit precedence and security-sensitive effective values can be traced to their source layer. No article drafting, visualization, Publication Candidate creation or publication was performed.

researchObjects.judgment: Durable authorization should preserve a broad default and a narrow occurrence-scoped exception while keeping actor/authority evidence and effect evidence separate; persistence of the exact decision does not prove approver identity or exactly-once external execution.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 持久化 Authorization 应同时保留宽泛 Default 与窄范围 Occurrence-scoped Exception，并把 Actor/Authority Evidence、Effect Evidence 分离；Exact Decision 的持久化不能证明 Approver Identity 或外部 Exactly-once Execution。

researchObjects.judgment: Pre-materialization coordination should distinguish reserved identity, pending host intent, authoritative materialization and cleanup/reconciliation; a reservation provides correlation but is not proof that the object exists.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: Pre-materialization Coordination 应区分 Reserved Identity、Pending Host Intent、Authoritative Materialization 与 Cleanup/Reconciliation；Reservation 提供 Correlation，但不是对象已经存在的证明。

researchObjects.judgment: Deterministic configuration precedence defines conflict resolution, not authorization; robust multi-layer configuration should also expose provenance for security-relevant effective values and preserve explicit ownership of later execution-scoped settings.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: Deterministic Configuration Precedence 定义的是冲突解析，而不是 Authorization；稳健的多层配置还应暴露安全相关 Effective Value 的 Provenance，并保留更晚 Execution-scoped Setting 的显式 Ownership。
